subject: Cross-border offer: visa reimbursement & lump-sum allowance for Senior SWE - approval needed
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Chen <sara.chen@talentbridge.co>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-border offer: Alex Gomez — visa & relocation cost ask

Hi Aditya / Lauren —

Following the final loop with Alex (candidate), TalentBridge shared salary expectations and relocation constraints. We want to move quickly; Alex accepted the verbal offer pending written confirmation. Before I send the formal offer, I need approvals on the international cost components so comp can be finalized in Greenhouse and the offer letter attached.

Quick summary: 
- Role: Senior Software Engineer (frontend infra)
- Base: $195,000
- Equity: 0.35% 4-year
- Start date target: Nov 2, 2026
- Candidate currently in Spain; requires work visa for US.

Immigration / mobility asks (requested by candidate / TB):
1) One-time lump-sum relocation stipend: EUR 10,000 (~$10,800) to cover moving, flights, short-term housing.
2) Visa sponsorship + legal fees estimate: vendor quoted ~$6,200 (see attached immigration-quote-0821.pdf). This covers H-1B transfer + premium processing + related admin.
3) Temporary travel stipend for family visit: $1,200 (one-time).

Proposed Redwood contribution (what I recommend):
- Lump-sum relocation: $11,000 (paid as sign-on relocation reimbursement upon receipts within 90 days)
- Immigration costs: Redwood pays vendor directly; cap at $7,000 (to cover any overruns), candidate to sign repayment clause if voluntarily resigns within 6 months.
- Family travel stipend: $1,000 one-time.

Budget impact: total one-time ask = ~$19,000 (within EOY hiring pool for international hires). HR has confirmed we can treat relocation as lump-sum taxable payment.

Attachments: offer-letter-Alex_Gomez.pdf (draft with placeholders), immigration-quote-0821.pdf (vendor line items).

Action items: 
- Aditya: confirm we have headcount and manager sign-off for the adjusted comp band (this offer slightly above mid of band but within top-of-band for senior).
- Lauren: need approval to route payment to immigration vendor and to commit up to $7k for legal. Also confirm the repayment clause language is acceptable.

If we get quick approval I’ll issue the final offer today and cc TalentBridge / candidate for signature.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mina — quick replies: 

1) Headcount: Confirmed. This was an approved FTE in Q3 hiring plan under Eng Infra (headcount code ENG-INF-2026-Q3). Manager (Aditya) has bandwidth and exec sponsor.
2) Compensation band: $195k base + 0.35% is slightly above the midpoint for Senior SWE but within discretionary band for high-impact ICs; I’m fine approving as-is. No need to escalate.
3) Relocation & immigration: the numbers look reasonable. Two small asks: 
   - Can we cap the lump-sum to $10k (net of currency fluctuation) to keep parity with other recent hires?
   - If we’re doing direct payment to vendor, make sure we have vendor W9 / contracting paperwork in Procurement.

Mina: can you confirm whether the repayment clause is standard? Also please confirm whether the EUR payment route is necessary or we can pay USD to vendor/candidate (simpler).

If we tighten the lump-sum to $10k and vendor cap to $7k, I’ll approve right away.

- Aditya

Redwood Inference
From: Global Immigration (Legal Partners) <immigration@legalpartners.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sara Chen <sara.chen@talentbridge.co>
Date: 2026-08-22T07:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Immigration quote - Alex Gomez (Spain)

Hi Mina / Sara —

Thanks for the details. Quick clarifications on the quote you received: 
- The $6,200 estimate assumes an H-1B transfer + premium processing with standard documentation. If candidate requires family-based dependent filings (H-4) we estimate an extra $900–$1,200.
- We can invoice Redwood directly in USD. Typical timeline from filing to approval with premium is ~2–3 weeks for adjudication.
- Refunds: we do not refund legal work if the petition is denied, but we carry out pre-filing checks to minimize risk.

If Redwood wants a cap at $7,000 we can commit to it and flag any line items that exceed the cap in advance for approval.

Regards,
Isabel Martinez
Senior Counsel, Global Immigration
Legal Partners
